title: The Fence, the Rule and the Law
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：law　|　正文 374 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 law 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: Two families in our street spent eleven years arguing about a fence, and in the end neither of them went to ① law, which surprised everybody who had enjoyed the argument. What settled it was not the ② law but a rule nobody had written down: the fence belongs to whoever mends it. The law, a solicitor told them eventually, would have cost more than the fence and settled less.

I was seventeen and following the case the way other people follow a team. My ③ law of the matter, formed then and never revised, is that most disputes are about the thing that was said, not the thing that was done. The ④ law of the land, as my grandmother called it, is something else: it is what happens when the thing that was said is written down and somebody is paid to read it slowly.

There is a third kind, which children learn before either. The law of the fence, everybody knew, was older than either family. The ⑤ law of the playground — that a rule must be capable of being stated in one sentence, and must apply to the person stating it — is the oldest and the most ⑥ lawless of the three, because nobody enforces it. My grandmother, who kept order in a house of nine, had no ⑦ law degree and never needed one.

In 2009 the fence was replaced by agreement, eleven inches inside the line the map gave, and both families ⑧ laid down the law about who had been reasonable, which is the part that never ends. What I remember is the solicitor's letter: one page, four sentences, and a bill. He said the ⑨ law is a blunt instrument and a slow one, and that people come to it last, after they have exhausted everything that works.

The families still do not speak. That is not a failure of the ⑩ law, which was never consulted; it is a failure of the rule about fence-mending, which was. I have since sat on two committees and one jury, and I have come to believe the opposite of what I believed at seventeen: the law is not what settles things. It is what we invent, slowly and expensively, for the cases where nothing else has.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 法律；法（成文法、法律体系）
B. n. 法则；规律；定律（自然、社会的规律）
C. n. 规矩；规矩准则；不成文的规则
D. n. 法学；法律专业（a law degree）
E. adj. 不受法律约束的；无法无天的（lawless）
F. 固定搭配：go to law 诉诸法律；打官司
G. 固定搭配：lay down the law 发号施令；定下规矩
H. n. （某人对某事的）看法；准则；道理

items.q: neither of them went to law
What settled it was not the law
the most lawless of the three
both families laid down the law about who had been reasonable
He said the law is a blunt instrument
That is not a failure of the law

answers.why: go to law 意为“诉诸法律、打官司”，说两家最终都没上法院。
指法律本身，说解决这事的是不成文规矩而不是法律。
one's law of the matter 指“某人对这件事的看法、准则”。
the law of the land 意为“国法、法律”，祖母的说法：说出口的话被写下来还有人慢读，那就是国法。
指 playground 的“规矩、不成文规则”，说规则必须一句话说得清且适用于立规矩的人。
lawless 意为“无法无天的、不受约束的”，说这类规矩最没人执行。
a law degree 意为“法学学位”，说祖母没有法学学位也从不需要。
lay down the law 意为“定规矩、发号施令”，说两家人各自宣称自己才是讲道理的。
指法律这个工具，律师说它既钝又慢。
此处 law 指更广义的“法则、规律”，说两家不说话不是规律本身的失败。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 最后两家人都没有去打官司。（go to law）
解决这件事的不是法律，而是一条不成文的规矩。（law）
国法就是：说出口的话被写下来，还有人付费慢慢读。（the law of the land）
操场上的规矩最无法无天，因为没人执行。（lawless）
她没有法学学位，也从来不需要。（law degree）
两家人各自宣称自己才是讲道理的那一方。（lay down the law）
answers: In the end neither family went to law.
What settled it was not the law but an unwritten rule.
The law of the land is what happens when the thing that was said is written down and somebody is paid to read it slowly.
The law of the playground is the most lawless of the three, because nobody enforces it.
She had no law degree and never needed one.
Both families laid down the law about who had been reasonable.
